Gym series · G2

Gym Challenge

Released October 16, 2000 · 132 cards

Gym Challenge is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Gym series, released in English on October 16, 2000. It has 132 cards. It includes 95 Pokémon, 31 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
